title: CSE: Parallel Finite State Machines with Convergence Set Enumeration
relevance: Primary reference. Introduces convergence set enumeration for parallel FSM execution. Achieves 2-8.6x speedup over lookback enumeration across 13 benchmarks including Huffman decoding.

title: Combining SIMD and Many/Multi-core Parallelism for Finite State Machines with Enumerative Speculation
relevance: Combines SIMD and multi-core parallelism for FSMs using enumerative speculation. Shows up to 95x speedup on Intel Xeon Phi. Includes Huffman decoding as a benchmark application.

title: Challenging the 'embarrassingly sequential': parallelizing finite state machine-based computations through principled speculation
relevance: Foundational work on principled speculation for FSM parallelization. Establishes theoretical framework for when speculative FSM execution is profitable.

title: Scaling out speculative execution of finite-state machines with parallel merge
relevance: Develops parallel merge techniques for FSM speculation on GPUs. Shows 2-6.74x improvement over sequential merge, enabling better scalability.
